summary: Operator site confirms 23 full-hookup sites, pool/laundry/store/wifi, open all year, ResNexus booking with holiday 3-night minimum; no nightly rate posted and ResNexus walled (unread). Branson gateway 22 km lifts the price gate; Google listing was the wrong park.
flags: Private gates: PRICE - no nightly rate on the operator's site (only monthly $600 off-season / $700 in season) and the ResNexus engine is behind Incapsula (unread to plain HTTP and empty in headless Chrome). A dated camper report: RV Life review stayed 7/2026, '$45 USD a night' on a pull-thru (also $40 in 9/2022). RV Life $$ (avg_rate $31). Gateway: Branson / Silver Dollar City within 40 km (22 km; the operator says Silver Dollar City is 10.3 miles), which lifts the $50 gate anyway. Family has not stayed. PRESENCE passes (working site + phone 417-739-5267). Ratings: Google 4.3 (42), RV Life 4.5 (4) - nothing under 4.0. No fees written (camper reports may only price an entry whose operator has no web page).

Long-stay tests (weekly/monthly marketed; two mobile homes rented long-term): (1) $45 camper report 7/2026 and Branson gateway - pass; (2) the site posts no nightly rate, but it says 'All reservations are made ... using our Resnexus' and the 7/2026 and 9/2022 RV Life reviews were short transient stays - passes on the engine, though the engine was not readable this time; (3) only a 3-night holiday minimum - pass; (4) UNVERIFIED - the one-night occupancy check could not be run (ResNexus walled); imagery shows the RV lanes north of the office densely filled; (5) an RV park with a cabin and two mobile homes - pass. Not called a drop candidate; a human could confirm the nightly share with a ResNexus search by hand.

Google identity: the brief's 'Kimberling City' query hit Table Rock Lake RV Resort & Marina (78 Kimberling Blvd, tablerockcamping.com, 4.3/53, (417) 739-4627) - a different park; the right listing is at 2799 State Hwy OO, Reeds Spring.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands: the sites sit in woods along two lanes north of Hwy OO; the nearest lake water (an Aunts Creek arm) is ~400 m away through forest, and the operator itself says a '5 minute walk' to the public use area.
Pin 36.6731,-93.4574 is the office/store at the Hwy OO entrance (Google 36.67319,-93.45739); the RV lanes run 0-250 m north of it, centroid ~130 m - no move.
